probes.asks: when the medium carries something, does it make any more of it, or lose any of it, on the way?
probes.found: a disturbance in G^XOR · relaxing(2/1) is not carried: integrated over where the two worlds differ it goes 3, 4, 7, 19, 31, 48, 76, 109, 128, 156, 223, 253, 305, 362, 409, 464. Nothing that spreads through this medium is diluted by the room it spreads into, because some of it is being made or lost on the way

measured.name: the disturbance, integrated, tick by tick
measured.note: 3, 4, 7, 19, 31, 48, 76, 109, 128, 156, 223, 253, 305, 362, 409, 464 over 16 ticks on square-4, box 21, wrapped so nothing can leave - the total difference between a perturbed world and an unperturbed one at the same seed, under EVERY rule of G^XOR · relaxing(2/1). Over the second half it trends 48.643 a tick against a standard error of 1.375, which is 35.4 sigma from flat
